guide.conditional_step: L4 whole-bottle lock guide is a separate contextual hint, not mandatory sixth step in every level
guide.entry_policy: Manual guide start or existing approved first-use trigger only. Do not invent auto-launch, persistent completion flags or reset them on locale change. First-use policy remains unresolved.
guide.events: Names in layouts are semantic adapter requirements, not verified existing code symbols. Bind authoritative current runtime state/events.
guide.advance: Next/Done starts disabled; enable only after matching semantic event commits for the same attempt, bottle and order identity. Ignore unrelated events, animation callbacks and stale IDs. A click on Next before ready is a no-op. No timer auto-advance.
guide.failure: Invalid target, full target, locked/busy bottle, empty-area click, canceled pour or rejected action never satisfies gate. Preserve current step and use existing feedback, no fake completion.
guide.undo: If the required state is undone before advancing, recompute gate and disable Next. Never undo puzzle state on behalf of tutorial.
guide.no_suitable_target: Do not fabricate source/target or reset board. Suspend interactive guide and allow skip/help; resume only with a valid target. For seal/delivery/win explanations, do not require the entire stage be completed merely to dismiss: Skip remains available.
guide.skip_close: Dismiss overlay only, restore original control state; no move/energy changes, no fake delivered/unlocked event or tutorial completion claim.
guide.pause: Follow current verified game timer/animation pause semantics; never introduce tutorial-specific timer changes. Resume same attempt. Locale changes preserve step and authoritative gate.
guide.restore: Re-resolve entity IDs and gates after stable checkpoint restore. Do not serialize intermediate animation frames or carry old callbacks into new orders.

highlight_and_overlay.holes: Resolve actual rendered node bounds in overlay-local coordinates, include safe-area/contain transform once. Sample rectangles in layouts and QA punched PNGs are fixtures only. Support multiple holes.

click_ring.geometry: Two simple concentric circular strokes centered at target interaction point; no hand image, no orientation problem
click_ring.contract_only: Optional static tap indicator, no animation delivered

highlight_and_overlay.input: Dimmer intercepts all background input. Hole transparency alone MUST NOT forward touches. Forward only whitelisted intended source/target interactions during select/pour; other guide stages are informational and use actual existing controls as permitted. Never globally unlock locked/busy nodes. Invalid operations remain subject to game validator.
highlight_and_overlay.placement: Card must not overlap resolved hole or required target. Lower card for upper bottles/order region; upper card for lower bottle. If no safe placement exists, suppress interactive guide and offer read-only help rather than obscure controls.
highlight_and_overlay.focus: Modal focus cycles through Skip and enabled Next/Done; read-only help includes Back/Close/Next. Escape/system back closes child only; restores opener. Minimum touch region 44 logical px after safe-area scale.
highlight_and_overlay.button_states: Reuse blue/gold ninepatch, pressed brightness .90, disabled .48; focused outline #FFF5DE 3 basis px outside bounds. Visual feedback only, no new texture style.
highlight_and_overlay.overlay_assets: No fixed-hole runtime PNG needed; renderer uses contract. qa/overlay_*_REFERENCE_ONLY.png cannot be shipped as level masks.
